description: Dashboard totals for one site: visitors, visits and pageviews (counts), bounce_rate (percent, 0–100), views_per_visit, duration (average visit length in seconds), live (visitors with a pageview in the last five minutes) and the previous-period comparison. Same as GET /api/v1/sites/:id/overview. Requires a paid plan (Starter or Growth); Hobby callers receive an upgrade message.

f.description: Optional dashboard filter string, the same as the f query on GET /api/v1.

range.description: Time range: today, 7d, 30d, 90d, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD (yesterday is the same date twice). Days follow the site timezone.

site_id.description: Site UUID, as returned by list_sites or add_website.

name: get_overview
title: Site overview
